::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Phra Narai Semicon Systems Labs, incorporated in Aug 2024 with its registered office in Dibrugarh, Assam (founder and CEO Bhubon Chandra Mech, CTO Deepak Babu); engineering team at the DIAT (DRDO campus) Innovation & Incubation Centre in Pune. Develops wireless IP and SoCs for MIMO, satellite communication and Wi-Fi, and offers ASIC/FPGA design services. Small team; no tape-out publicly reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Wireless baseband IP cores and custom SoCs/ASICs for MIMO, SATCOM and Wi-Fi systems; verification IP.
